item.tarp.pole.tip: Click a start and an end point. Until it catches another point it only extends straight up/down. One item = 2 blocks. Sneak-right-click to cancel
item.tarp.rope.tip: Click stake heads or pole ends in turn. Sneak-right-click to stop
item.tarp.tarp.tip: Click tie points in turn, then the first one again to pitch. Sneak-right-click to cancel
item.tarp.leaf_cover.tip: Stand-in for a tarp. Dries away after a day
item.tarp.tarp.remove: Take down: break the pitched cloth (left-click) or right-click it with shears; tarp and ropes come back
tarp.msg.pole.fell: It could not stand and fell
tarp.msg.rope.not_anchor: Ropes tie only to stake heads or pole ends
tarp.msg.tarp.shape: The outline crosses itself or is too small
tarp.msg.tarp.not_anchor: Tie points must be stake heads or pole ends
tarp.msg.tarp.exposed: A pole sticks out of the cloth (red)
tarp.msg.tarp.need_ropes: Needs one rope per tie point (%s)
tarp.msg.tarp.placed: Pitched (area %s blocks²). Sneak-click the cloth with an empty hand to cut a door
tarp.msg.tarp.auto_none: Needs at least 3 stakes around to suggest an outline
tarp.msg.door.set: Door cut. Right-click with an empty hand to open or close
tarp.msg.door.preview: Door preview. Sneak-click the same side again to confirm
tarp.msg.door.not_axis: Doors go only on sides along x or z
tarp.msg.door.too_low: The cloth does not rise 2 blocks above the floor
tarp.hint.pole.count: %s poles · length %s · scroll: adjust length · sneak+right-click: cancel
tarp.hint.pole.vertical: Vertical · %s poles · length %s · scroll: adjust length (aim at another point to angle it)
tarp.hint.tarp.points: %s tie points (3 or more, then click the first to pitch)
tarp.hint.tarp.bad_shape: The outline crosses itself or is too small
tarp.hint.tarp.ready: Area %s blocks² · needs: %s · %s · click the first point to pitch
tarp.hint.tarp.problem.shape: The outline crosses itself or is too small
tarp.hint.tarp.problem.not_anchor: Area %s blocks² · some points cannot be tied (red)
tarp.hint.tarp.problem.too_big: Area %s blocks² · needs: %s · this tarp is too small
tarp.hint.tarp.problem.exposed: Area %s blocks² · a pole sticks out (red)
item.tarp.tent_kit.empty: Empty · sneak + right-click a pitched tent's canvas to pack it
item.tarp.tent_kit.howto: Hold to project · Q/E rotate · right-click to anchor
tarp.hint.kit.empty: Empty kit · sneak + right-click a pitched tent's canvas to pack it
tarp.hint.kit.bad: Can't place: %s mismatched ground cells (red) · Q/E: rotate
tarp.hint.kit.stage: Next: %s · right-click a yellow part · sneak+right-click: un-anchor
tarp.hint.kit.aim: Aim at one of the %s and right-click
tarp.msg.kit.full: This kit already holds a tent
tarp.msg.kit.capture.wall_stake: Tents staked into trees or walls can't be packed
tarp.msg.kit.capture.shared: Shares parts with another tent; can't pack
tarp.msg.kit.no_anchor: Nothing to tie it to yet
tarp.msg.kit.done: Tent pitched · the kit is empty
tarp.configuration.title: TARP Settings
tarp.configuration.kitInstantPitch.toolt: When on, the whole tent is pitched the moment you anchor the projection. When off, right-click poles → stakes → cords → tarp one by one.
